title: Dataflow Gen2 Low-Code Transformation Flow
purpose: Trace Power Query authoring through managed staging, destination writes, and pipeline orchestration.
accessibleSummary: Source connectors feed Power Query transformations. Dataflow Gen2 uses managed Fabric SQL staging for scale-out processing, writes one or more destinations, and can run as a pipeline activity with monitoring.
longDescription: Authors connect to supported sources and define Power Query steps. Publishing validates the draft. At runtime Fabric may use internal DataflowsStagingLakehouse and DataflowsStagingWarehouse items for SQL-backed scale-out. Curated output is written to configured Fabric or external destinations. Pipelines schedule and coordinate the dataflow with other movement and transformation steps.

nodes.summary: Dataflow Gen2 connects Power Query to Fabric, cloud, and on-premises sources.
nodes.detail: Dataflow Gen2 connects Power Query to Fabric, cloud, and on-premises sources. Establish connections and read source schemas.
nodes.whyItMatters: Source queries on the Power Query canvas depends on making this responsibility and its operating boundary explicit.

evidence.note: Dataflow Gen2 provides Power Query over hundreds of source connectors.

processing: Establish connections and read source schemas

drill.example: An analyst connects to an ERP table through an approved gateway.
controls: Gateway, credential owner, privacy, and connector settings

nodes.label: Power Query shaping
nodes.summary: Authors define joins, cleansing, types, and aggregations as applied steps.
nodes.detail: Authors define joins, cleansing, types, and aggregations as applied steps. Apply typed, ordered Power Query transformations and publish validations.
nodes.whyItMatters: A versioned transformation definition depends on making this responsibility and its operating boundary explicit.

evidence.note: Dataflow Gen2 is the low-code shaping surface with hundreds of transformations.

inputs: Connected source queries and a target data contract
processing: Apply typed, ordered Power Query transformations and publish validations
drill.example: Orders are typed, joined to customers, filtered, and aggregated.
controls: Step order, parameters, and schema rules
failureModes: A non-folding step pulls unnecessary data into the mashup engine

nodes.label: Managed SQL staging
nodes.summary: Fabric provisions internal staging items for scale-out Dataflow processing.
nodes.detail: Fabric provisions internal staging items for scale-out Dataflow processing. Stage intermediates and execute supported work on Fabric SQL compute.
nodes.whyItMatters: Prepared rows ready for destination writes depends on making this responsibility and its operating boundary explicit.

evidence.note: Gen2 provisions DataflowsStagingLakehouse and DataflowsStagingWarehouse for SQL-backed processing.

nodes.label: Configured destinations
nodes.summary: One dataflow can write transformed output to multiple Fabric or external destinations.
nodes.detail: One dataflow can write transformed output to multiple Fabric or external destinations. Create, append, replace, or update according to destination configuration.
nodes.whyItMatters: Curated destination tables or files depends on making this responsibility and its operating boundary explicit.

evidence.note: Gen2 writes to multiple Fabric and external destinations including Lakehouse, Warehouse, KQL, SQL, and files.

processing: Create, append, replace, or update according to destination configuration
drill.example: The same conformed customer result loads a lakehouse and Azure SQL.
failureModes: Wrong replace or append mode duplicates or deletes expected rows

nodes.label: Pipeline orchestration
nodes.summary: A pipeline schedules the dataflow and coordinates downstream activities.
nodes.detail: A pipeline schedules the dataflow and coordinates downstream activities. Run the dataflow, observe status, and gate downstream work.
nodes.whyItMatters: Operational completion signal and downstream hand-off depends on making this responsibility and its operating boundary explicit.

evidence.note: Pipelines can invoke Dataflow Gen2 as a scheduled activity.

inputs: Published dataflow, dependencies, schedule, and parameters
processing: Run the dataflow, observe status, and gate downstream work

controls: Retry, dependency, parameter, and alert policy
failureModes: Retrying a non-idempotent destination write duplicates data
